purpose: Execute the candidate-exposed inside/boundary/outside forcing-domain primary after Reference-only threshold-transfer adjudication, without changing the contract-normalized rho design or P2E14 thresholds.

matrix.materials: all 36 D3R materials B01-B18 and O01-O18

primary_route_endpoint.rule: For every case with a valid matched Reference request, RossFast must converge on |rho|<=1 and must fail closed on |rho|=1.05. No automatic Reference fallback is allowed.

pairwise_scientific_endpoint.rule: For the 850 Stage-A-authorized |rho|<=1 cases with both routes valid, every one of five Reference-versus-RossFast discrepancy metrics must be <= its unchanged exact-Se P2E14 threshold.
pairwise_scientific_endpoint.policy_for_these_14_cases: Retain and execute for route-boundary evidence. Record paired discrepancies diagnostically if both routes converge, but do not classify them as scientific admissibility pass/fail under P2E14.

outside_endpoint.rule: For every |rho|=1.05 case with valid Reference fixed-step request, RossFast must not publish SW_SOLVE_CONVERGED, must retain rejected route provenance, and must not silently execute Reference.

hypotheses.H1: The exact state-local forcing envelope is a reproducible route boundary across all 36 materials and three common-state anchors.
hypotheses.H2: Among the 850 Stage-A-authorized route-valid inside/boundary cases, candidate-independent P2E14 scientific admission holds without threshold widening.
hypotheses.H3: All 432 just-outside cases fail closed with no silent fallback.

falsification.H1: Any inside or exact-boundary unexpected RossFast rejection, or any just-outside RossFast admission, is retained as a route-boundary mismatch.
falsification.H2: Any authorized pairwise discrepancy failure narrows the scientific substitution domain. No threshold or case membership may change.
falsification.H3: Any outside converged RossFast result or silent fallback falsifies fail-closed behavior for that case.

next_permitted_action: Implement and execute the exact 1296-case candidate boundary harness. Do not modify thresholds, rho values, Stage-A authorization, source physics or solver routes.
